title: signalExplanation.ts: consume WaveScreen.showed_pullback_in_lookback/showed_rally_in_lookback to remove the ambiguous-Wave caveat
description:
Filed from api-stocks-analysis-wave-lookback's own checklist item 5 (that task's `decisions` entry explains why it wasn't folded into that backend task itself). GET /api/stocks/{ticker}/analysis now exposes `screens.wave.showed_pullback_in_lookback`/`showed_rally_in_lookback` (bool | null, null only when `screens.tide.trend` is NEUTRAL) -- the exact `_wave_lookback` booleans `_determine_signal` (backend/app/signals/engine.py) actually gates BUY/SELL on, rather than just today's `screens.wave.state`.

`frontend/src/features/stocks/components/signalExplanation.ts`'s `explainSignal` currently has to render a `met: null` 'can't be confirmed from today's data alone' caveat for every HOLD case except the by-elimination one (see that module's own top-level docstring, 'The Wave lookback data-availability gap' section, for the full case breakdown). With the new field(s) exposed, every one of those cases can instead read the real value directly: `met: showed_pullback_in_lookback` (or `showed_rally_in_lookback`, depending on direction) whenever Tide is directional, with `met: null` genuinely only remaining for the Tide-Neutral case (where Wave was never evaluated against a direction at all -- already its own separate early-return branch in `explainSignal`, not the ambiguous-caveat one).

This is a real behavior change to a fairly dense piece of branching logic (the `waveMetToday`/`signal !== 'HOLD'`/`impulseMet && triggerMet`/else chain), not just a schema-typing update -- worth its own add-frontend-feature-skill pass (fixture/test rewrite across signalExplanation.test.ts, SignalExplanationContent.test.tsx's `ambiguousWaveScreens` fixture, and the module's own docstring) rather than folded into the backend task that unblocked it.

checklist.step: Rewrite explainSignal's wave-condition branch (frontend/src/features/stocks/components/signalExplanation.ts) to consume showed_pullback_in_lookback/showed_rally_in_lookback directly for every directional-Tide case, removing the 'other blockers' ambiguous-caveat branch entirely (met should never be null once Tide is directional -- only the Tide-Neutral early return should still produce met: null for Wave).
Update the module's own top-level docstring ('The Wave lookback data-availability gap' section) to describe the resolved behavior instead of the gap, or remove it if no longer relevant.

Update signalExplanation.test.ts's screens() fixture builder and test cases (and SignalExplanationContent.test.tsx's ambiguousWaveScreens fixture) to set showed_pullback_in_lookback/showed_rally_in_lookback explicitly per case and assert the new definitive met/detail text, removing coverage for the now-dead null-caveat branch.
Confirm SignalConditionExplanation.met's JSDoc ('null only for the Wave condition ... genuinely undeterminable') no longer applies, or narrow it to the Tide-Neutral case only.
Run frontend unit tests and the 90% coverage gate; update Storybook/browser-walkthrough coverage if task-qa-reviewer's checklist for this area expects it.
